correctness.rationale: Clock-conditioned group survival factorizes exactly. The symmetrized moment-transfer identity is an algebraic equality with pointwise nonnegative kernel for all Q in [0,1], proving both fixed-K extrema via a finite transfer chain. The group-splitting identity is a nonnegative product of monotone power differences. Brownian non-reset survival is erf(x0/sqrt(4Du)) and satisfies S0(u)=1-o(u) at zero with S0′(t)<0 for t>0, making Q nondegenerate and strictly positive at each t>0 under positive-rate Poisson clocks. This validates all quantifiers and strictness. A 70-assertion checker corroborates special cases but is not the proof.

originality.rationale: The full 2023 first-passage paper explicitly treats all-independent and fully simultaneous reset clocks, not permanent intermediate shared-clock partitions. A 2025 collective-reset full text treats stationary position statistics and non-Poisson interarrivals without the shared-target group-allocation problem. A 2025 event-triggered resetting gas is not an exogenous renewal-clock protocol. The new claim is a complete fixed-controller partition extremal and strict all-time stochastic-order classification; each implication is compared, not merely titles. General correlation/majorization priority remains a genuine risk.
residual_risks: Log-convexity of positive moments is standard, so a general previously published theorem on conditional-independence grouping or common-shock correlation could subsume this domain-specific classification.
Not every specialist source has been read; search result nonappearance does not establish priority.

value.rationale: The exact number of independent synchronized reset controllers is a natural constrained physical architecture between published fully independent and fully shared protocols. The theorem completely identifies the best and worst assignments of N searchers across K controllers and strict stochastic improvement through splitting, for all observation times and arbitrary increasing discovery-delay losses. This is a motivated natural complete classification; the four-searcher difference is only an explicit witness, not the primary source of value. It leaves engineering implementation cost and nonidentical/adaptive controllers unaddressed.
